Woman Argues with TTE, Tears Clothes

A young woman engaged in a heated argument with a Ticket TTE (Train Ticket Examiner) after allegedly not having a ticket. During the altercation, the woman tore her own clothes and stated, 'We will trap him.' The incident was captured on camera.
